data: Does the purple line in the lower panel cross the horizontal red line at a higher value of m compared to the green line?

The question asks whether the purple line in the lower panel crosses the horizontal red line at a higher value of m compared to the green line. 

From the caption, we know that the purple line corresponds to the threshold value qth = 0.1805, and the red line represents the value q = 0.1. The green line corresponds to q = 0.05.

In the lower panel, the purple line (qth = 0.1805) intersects the red line (q = 0.1) at approximately m = 6. On the other hand, the green line (q = 0.05) intersects the red line (q = 0.1) at approximately m = 4. 

Thus, the purple line crosses the horizontal red line at a higher value of m compared to the green line.
